improvement_prs.title: perf(gh-bridge): batch command log trimming instead of re-slicing every call
improvement_prs.notes: Task 8 (Performance). Fixed O(n) re-slice on every exec() call once commandLog hit 500-entry cap; now trims in batches at 2x cap. Added test asserting bounded size + most-recent retention. typecheck + 238 tests pass.
